episodeTitle.en: Lessons from a 2-time unicorn builder, 50-time startup advisor and 20-time board member | Uri Levine
episodeTitle.zh: 从两次独角兽公司创始人、50次创业顾问到20次董事会成员的经验谈 | 乌里·莱文

guestBioOfficial.en: Uri Levine is the co-founder of Waze, the world’s largest community-based traffic and navigation app, acquired by Google for over $1 billion. He’s also founded nine other companies, been on the board of 20 companies, and advised more than 50 companies. He’s most recently the author of Fall in Love with the Problem, Not the Solution: A Handbook for Entrepreneurs, hailed by Steve Wozniak as the “Bible for entrepreneurs.” Uri is dedicated to creating impactful startups that solve real-world problems and has seen everything from failure to moderate success to big success. In our conversation, we dig into: • Why falling in love with the problem is key to startup success
guestBioOfficial.zh: 乌里·莱文是全球最大社区导航应用Waze的联合创始人，该应用被谷歌以超过10亿美元的价格收购。他还创立了其他九家公司，担任过20家公司的董事会成员，并为50多家公司提供过咨询服务。他最新著作《爱上问题而非解决方案：创业者手册》被史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克誉为“创业者的圣经”。乌里致力于打造能解决现实问题的有影响力初创企业，见证了从失败到平庸成功再到巨大成功的全过程。在对话中，我们将深入探讨：• 爱上问题是创业成功的关键

title.en: Lessons from a 2-time unicorn builder, 50-time startup advisor and 20-time board member | Uri Levine
title.zh: 从两次独角兽公司创始人、50次创业顾问到20次董事会成员的经验谈 | 乌里·莱文

summary.en: Uri distills the biggest lessons from working with dozens of startups into one core idea: fall in love with the problem, not the solution. He shares why founders should validate the pain before building, stay ready to pivot when the data disagrees, and keep the user's problem front and center through every stage. The episode is a founder's field guide to building companies that actually matter.
summary.zh: Uri 将他与数十家初创公司共事所得的最大经验，提炼为一个核心理念：爱上问题，而非方案。他分享了为什么创始人应当在动手前先验证“痛点”、在数据相悖时随时准备转型，以及为何要在每个阶段都把用户的问题置于最前沿。本期是一份创始人的实战指南，关于打造真正有意义的公司。
